lines.A01: This is Cosy2Go: an electric slatted frame that simply replaces your old one.
lines.A02: Head and foot sections adjust separately and steplessly.
lines.A03: Two motors move you whisper-quietly into any position.
lines.A04: Only 10 centimetres high – it fits in any bed frame.
lines.A05: You control it by remote or app.
lines.A06: And it carries up to 150 kilos.
lines.A07: Available from 80 to 140 centimetres wide – plus special sizes.
lines.A08: Cosy2Go. Make more of your bed.
